cottage_window.text: Mist over Larkspur Hollow. Somewhere out there, a glass orchid is pretending to be missing jewelry.

cottage_desk.text: Celeste's note: 'Keycard trails lead through the badge terminal — ask me after the climate log.' Phone buzzes with a muffled threat… later.
cottage_desk.notebook: Celeste: check badge terminal after climate log. Don't rush accusations.

cottage_phone.text: A disguised voice: 'Leave the orchid alone.' Background — kiln fans, not café chatter. Studio ambience. Amateur hour.
cottage_phone.notebook: Phone threat used studio kiln ambience — not the café. Points at someone who knows the annex.

banner.text: SPRING GALA — GLASS & BLOOM. The typography is trying very hard to look expensive.

guestbook.text: Odd: Dr. Pembroke signed in at 23:40 last night — long after closing. Theo at 06:05. Rowan… unsigned, but the studio badge log might disagree.
guestbook.notebook: Iris entered the Orchid Wing after hours (23:40). Ask her why.

pedestal.text: Empty. The lock plate has a shallow crescent scratch — too elegant for a crowbar, too wrong for a standard pick. Someone brought specialty hardware.
pedestal.notebook: Pedestal lock shows a crescent scratch. Match it to a tool.

benches.text: Cattleya, Phragmipedium, a diva of a Vanda. The living orchids are fine. The glass one is the drama.

humidity_sheet.text: Iris's handwriting: Day 62% / Night 58%. Margin note: 'Panel override PIN = day||night||bench#' — and bench #3 is highlighted.
humidity_sheet.notebook: Climate PIN hint: combine day humidity, night humidity, and bench number.

specimens.text: Pressed Phalaenopsis from 1891. Someone labeled it 'almost as stubborn as Juliette's bid.' Gossip, archivally preserved.

liora_notebook.text: Liora's annealing card tucked in a blotter: soak 480°C → ramp 520 → hold 560. Studio oven keypad loves nostalgia.

workbench.text: Glass dust, graphite, and a receipt for tungsten wire. Rowan is either meticulous or carefully messy.

tool_rack.text: Standard picks, shears… and an empty hook labeled 'W-crescent.' The silhouette matches your pedestal sketch.
tool_rack.notebook: Empty tungsten crescent hook in studio. Scratches match the pedestal.

tool_rack_locked.text: Tools. Sharp. I should examine the crime scene before I start accusing hardware.

pawn_slip.text: Hollow Pawn & Loan receipt: grandfather's gold pocket watch. Theo's signature. Not an orchid fencing operation — unless orchids wear watch chains now.
pawn_slip.notebook: Theo pawned a grandfather's watch — ask him before assuming orchid guilt.

shed_shelf.text: Spare trowels, one boot with honest mud, zero glass orchids. Red herrings hate me.

compost.text: Warm compost. Nothing buried that sings like Liora's glass. Theo's work is messy, not criminal.

bid_ledger.text: Private bids: Juliette Crane — $80,000 for The Glass Orchid. Note: 'Celeste will see reason.' Charming.
bid_ledger.notebook: Juliette offered $80k privately. Confront her with the ledger.

champagne.text: Labels face outward for photos. Priorities.

cafe_menu.text: Today: Fog Latte, Orchid Macaron (almond, not glass), and 'Ask Finn Anything — first rumor free.'
